##### Project general facts

Bab Al Qasr Garden Residences 65, developed under the esteemed Bab Al Qasr brand, is a masterpiece of resort-inspired design, cleverly blending elegant architecture, lush green landscapes, and exceptional hospitality standards to create a unique residential oasis. This low-density community boasts an impressive array of residences, including simplex, duplex, and triplex sky villas with private elevators in selected units, offering a sophisticated living experience that seamlessly combines nature, privacy, and luxury. With a significant portion of the plot dedicated to landscaping and water features, the development's design is a testament to the brand's commitment to crafting a tranquil and exclusive environment.

The amenities at Bab Al Qasr Garden Residences 65 are meticulously designed to deliver a resort-style lifestyle, with a focus on wellness, recreation, and community living. Residents can indulge in multiple swimming pools, including an adult pool, family pools, a sandy beach pool, and kids' pools, as well as a paddle canal, jogging track, yoga and meditation gardens, outdoor fitness zones, and various sports courts, ensuring a balanced lifestyle that caters to diverse interests and preferences. The development also features rooftop infinity pools, climate-controlled lounges, cinemas, BBQ stations, and landscaped gardens, providing a wealth of opportunities for relaxation, entertainment, and socialization.

The interiors of Bab Al Qasr Garden Residences 65 are a symphony of refined European countryside elegance, combining timeless design with contemporary comfort and sophistication. Residences feature marble finishes, wooden flooring, soft color palettes, wallpaper accents, custom artwork, and abundant natural light, creating warm and inviting living spaces that exude luxury and refinement. With premium global brands such as Siemens, Samsung, SMEG, Roca, and OTIS, every aspect of the residences has been carefully considered to provide a turnkey luxury experience that embodies comfort, functionality, and long-term quality.


##### Location description and benefits

Masdar City, the location of this exceptional project, is a beacon of innovation and sustainability, offering a unique living environment that prioritizes wellbeing and environmental responsibility. The area is distinguished by its strategic connectivity and proximity to key destinations, including Abu Dhabi International Airport and Yas Island's world-class attractions, such as Ferrari World and Warner Bros. World. Residents have access to excellent transportation links, making it easy to explore the city's major business and leisure hubs.

The Masdar City community is renowned for its commitment to clean energy, eco-friendly design, and pedestrian-friendly streets, creating a truly unique and sustainable urban ecosystem. The presence of the Masdar Institute and cutting-edge technology companies fosters an environment of continuous learning and advancement, providing residents with opportunities to engage with experts and thought leaders. This exceptional location offers a distinctive blend of natural beauty, innovative spirit, and luxury living, making it an attractive destination for those seeking a refined and responsible lifestyle.

The area surrounding Masdar City is a treasure trove of attractions and experiences, with something to suit every interest and preference. From the thrill of Yas Island's theme parks to the serene beauty of the surrounding landscape, residents can enjoy a wide range of activities and pursuits, all within easy reach of their homes. With its focus on collaboration and innovation, Masdar City is a hub for knowledge exchange and advancement, offering a truly exceptional quality of life that extends beyond its physical boundaries.
